text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Friday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanians living abroad want the government to establish a department to deal with issues which affect them.
- Half of the Poles living in the Vilnius region would like their children to attend Lithuanian language schools.
- The minister of justice, Vytautas Pakalnishkis, signed an agreement with the United Nations Development Programme to finance a crime prevention centre in Vilnius.
